owner.timezone: The IANA time zone for schedules, the daily summary and times shown.
engine.port: The console, Mini App and WebSocket port.
engine.extraOrigins: More browser origins allowed to reach the engine.
engine.unlock.mode: Where the agent key and the Privy app secret are read at start.
engine.unlock.mode:default: keychain with a desktop session, else file
engine.unlock.command: The command that prints the agent key; used when mode is command.
engine.shutdownBudgetMs: The time limit of the shutdown order, in milliseconds.
custody.privy.appSecret: The owner's Privy app secret, as a secret source.
custody.privy.ownerKeyPublic: The owner key's public half, written by binference init.
telegram.webhookSecret: Checks webhook calls; required with the webhook mode.
telegram.topicsPerAgent: One direct-message topic per agent, once the bot has topics turned on.
telegram.replies.stream: progress shows a status message once the agent works, then the answer as a new message; partial grows the answer in one message that becomes the answer itself.
telegram.replies.reasoning: How the model's reasoning shows: off hides it, streamed shows it while the agent works, kept sends it as a message of its own before the answer.
models: Model providers and the models the agent uses.
models.providers.<provider>.baseUrl: Where to call; the binference AI gateway for the binference kind.
models.main: The model that talks and proposes.
models.fast: The model that writes summaries, compacts and classifies.
models.vision: The model that reads images when the main one cannot.
models.imageMaking: The model that makes images: on the bInference gateway, one of its image models; on an openai provider, an Images API model.
models.videoMaking: The model that makes videos: one of the bInference gateway's video models.
models.speech: What speaks the agent's words when the owner asks for voice: a speech model on an openai provider, or local for this machine's own voice on macOS.
models.imageInput: The models that take images as input; any other model gets the vision model's description.
models.fallbacks.main: Models tried in order when the main one fails.
models.fallbacks.fast: Models tried in order when the fast one fails.
models.idleTimeoutMs: No output for this many milliseconds aborts a model request.
models.cooldownMs: How long a failing provider rests, in milliseconds.
models.loopDetection: Stops a turn that repeats its tool calls.
models.prices: Model prices that replace the built-in table.
models.prices.<model>.inputPerMTokUsd: US dollars per million input tokens.
models.prices.<model>.outputPerMTokUsd: US dollars per million output tokens.
models.prices.<model>.cachedPerMTokUsd: US dollars per million cached input tokens.
defaults: What each new agent starts with; copied into its rows once, at creation.
defaults.limits.perTradeUsd: The most one trade may move, in US dollars.
defaults.limits.rollingDayUsd: The most trades and sends may move in 24 hours, in US dollars.
defaults.limits.slippageBps.registry: Slippage allowed on registry tokens, in basis points.
defaults.limits.slippageBps.other: Slippage allowed on every other token, in basis points.
defaults.limits.priceImpactBps: The largest price impact allowed, in basis points.
defaults.limits.taxBps: The largest token tax allowed, in basis points.
defaults.limits.liquidityFloorUsd: The least pool liquidity a trade needs, in US dollars.
defaults.limits.gasReserve.<chain>: The native coin kept for gas, per chain.
defaults.limits.allowTokens: Tokens allowed; empty allows every token that passes the risk check.
defaults.approvalMode: Whether trades within the caps wait for a tap.
defaults.ceiling.perTxBnb: The Privy policy's per-transaction cap, in BNB.
defaults.cards.tradeExpirySec: A trade card expires after this many seconds.
defaults.cards.otherExpirySec: Other cards expire after this many seconds.
defaults.cards.requoteAfterSec: A quote older than this many seconds is taken again.
defaults.cards.requoteToleranceBps: A new quote this much worse asks again, in basis points.
defaults.orders.expiryDays: An auto order expires after this many days.
defaults.copy.perBuyUsd: The most one copied buy may spend, in US dollars.
defaults.copy.perLeaderDayUsd: The most copies of one leader may spend a day, in US dollars.
defaults.modelBudgetUsdPerDay: The most model calls may cost a day, in US dollars.
defaults.notifications.muted: Notice kinds muted; security notices cannot be muted.
defaults.notifications.dailySummaryTime: When the daily summary goes, in the owner's time, as HH:mm.
chains.rpc.<chain>.tracer: The URL of your RPC that answers debug_traceTransaction, such as a paid node's. binference asks it what a trade received once the public RPCs dropped an old block.
chains.rpc.<chain>.ws: The wss:// URL of your RPC that pushes new blocks, such as a paid node's. The price watcher follows each new block through it, and polls the RPCs while it is down.
chains.relays.<chain>: Private relays for sends, per chain.
chains.maxFeePerGasGwei.<chain>: The network fee cap per chain, in gwei: a higher fee per gas asks the owner.
venues.keys.relay: Relay's API key, sent with every Relay request. Without one Relay answers at a lower rate, and a Relay deposit's status reads only until Relay retires that read on 2026-11-24.
venues.kyberClientId: The client id sent to KyberSwap.
risk.cacheTtlSec: How long risk answers are kept, in seconds.
search.provider:default: the first of brave and tavily with a key
remote.mini: Whether binference expose published the Mini App over Tailscale serve; a record, so changing it publishes nothing.
remote.webhooks: Whether binference expose --webhooks published the webhook path over Tailscale funnel; a record, so changing it publishes nothing.
remote.publicUrl: The HTTPS address where the owner's own proxy publishes the engine's port: /console opens its /mini in Telegram, and its origin may open the engine's socket, the console and the Mini App's image uploads, never pairing; it must serve nothing else.
backups.daily: Takes an encrypted backup every day.
backups.copyTo: A folder that gets a second copy.
updates.check: Checks for a newer version once a day.
telemetry.enabled: Adds opt-in counts to the daily update check.
network.proxy: The owner's proxy as an http:// or https:// URL, its user name and password included: every outbound request but those to this machine, addresses off the internet and noProxy goes through it as a tunnel.
network.noProxy: Hosts reached without the proxy, at most 256: * for every host, a name in punycode that also covers the names under it, an IP address or [IPv6], each with an optional :port, or an address block such as 10.0.0.0/8.
chats.keepDays: Days chats are kept, or forever.
chats.newMessageMode: Whether a message during a turn merges in or waits for the turn to end.
logging.maxFileMb: A log file rotates at this many megabytes.
cex.binance.enabled: Turns on the Binance Agent OS plugin.
shell.run: any lets the agent run commands on this machine, away from binference's own folder; off runs none.
shell.timeoutSeconds: A command's time limit in seconds when the agent names none; 0 for none.
files: Where the agent's file tools reach.
files.workspaceOnly: true keeps the agent's file reads, writes and edits inside its workspace; false lets them reach any file but binference's own folder.
files.patchWorkspaceOnly: true keeps the agent's patches inside its workspace; false lets them change any file but binference's own folder.
browser.enabled: Lets the agent drive a browser of its own on this machine, with its own profile in binference's folder.
browser.headless: true runs the agent's browser without a window; unset, it shows a window where this machine has a desktop.
browser.executablePath: The program of the Chrome-family browser the agent drives; unset, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave or Chromium as found on this machine.
browser.evaluate: Lets the agent run scripts in the pages its browser opens.
browser.allowPrivateNetwork: Lets the agent's browser open addresses on this machine and private networks; binference's own engine, console and folder stay refused.
speech: How the agent speaks when the owner asks for voice.
speech.voice: The voice the agent speaks with: one of the speech model's voices, such as alloy, or with local one of this machine's, such as Samantha; the model's or the machine's own when unset.
plugins: Each plugin's settings, by plugin id.
plugins.<plugin>.<setting>: One plugin's settings, as its own schema reads them.
